#215 F002 repair check: PASS

Exact head: `952f305936f4596366ccf9b322f11be0cfaaf357`. Scoped to F002/S215-002, its test fix and the documented outcome; the intervening main merge is not a new whole-PR review.

**F002 closed.** The same-default case no longer claims the seat stayed on Sonnet. After a submitted switch whose application cannot be distinguished from an unchanged global default, `cheap_return::switch_back` records an unknown model (`None`), with `unconfirmed: true`, `returned: false`, the last confirmed model and an explanatory reason in the audit. A positive settings-change witness still records the remembered model; the distinguishable no-switch case retains Sonnet. No successful return is claimed merely because its dialog was confirmed: confirmation and observed application are separate facts.

The focused regression starts with the global default already equal to `claude-fable-5` and the session recorded on Sonnet, presents/confirms the dialog after typing `/model`, then asserts unknown recorded model, the unconfirmed audit, the last-confirmed Sonnet value, no false “stays on Sonnet” explanation, and byte-identical settings. The lack of stronger pane/session evidence and the explicit-model recovery path are documented limits, not concealed success.

**Evidence:** `just pr-freeze 215` returned FINAL at this head; detached tree clean. [CI run 42757530097](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42757530097) records the exact head. Its successful Rust job's [JUnit artifact 13735844387](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42757530097/artifacts/13735844387) contains 2,412 executed tests, zero failures/errors; nextest reports six additional skips. The exact same-default regression ran and passed, as did the timed successful return, late-dialog, failed-snapshot/bad-model and never-started-compaction cases.

No new launch, timer or periodic work in this fix. Source and exact-head CI evidence only; no local builds/tests, real settings reads/changes, lifecycle operations or product edits. Earlier F001/F003 closures remain unchanged.
